mapper.select: SELECT notice_id, category, title, views, created_at FROM notices WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT notice_id, category, title, content, views, created_at, updated_at FROM notices WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT notice_id, category, title, content, views, created_at FROM notices WHERE category = #{category} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (category, title, content) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
UPDATE notices SET views = views + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
